body.ruleText:
rule password_spray_then_success {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineering"
    description = "Ten or more blocked logins for one user from one address, then an allowed login for that user from that address, within 30 minutes."
    severity = "High"
    priority = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001,TA0003,TA0004,TA0005,TA0006"
    technique = "T1078,T1110.003"
    opentide_uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8003-000000000062"
    opentide_version = "1"

  events:
    $fail.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $fail.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $fail.principal.ip = $ip
    $fail.target.user.userid = $user

    $success.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $success.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $success.principal.ip = $ip
    $success.target.user.userid = $user

    $fail.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < $success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $user, $ip over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(80)
    $risk_entity_to_score = $user
    $failed_attempts = count_distinct($fail.metadata.id)
    $target_hosts = array_distinct($success.target.hostname)

  condition:
    #fail >= 10 and $success

  options:
    suppression_window = 1h
}
